'''Kristin Dion''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dagobah Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|big blue ROps]], according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1056">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-dagobah-regional-29-june-2000d1056/ dagobah-regional-29-june-2000], DeckTech (Charlie "CommieBoy" Herren, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-dagobah-regional-29-june-2000d1056/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
